assertions.name: the +2.1° residual is odd-in-h (bar-anti-symmetric), bracketed by consecutive odd powers
assertions.source: h·z³ (1.49°) < 2.1° < h·z² (2.99°); even (cosh, h²) candidates are the wrong parity for a chiral residue

description: Identifies the H₂S +2.1° residual as the bar-ANTI-symmetric (chiral / P_skew, odd-in-h) channel of the bar-involution. H₂O's two self-dual lone pairs (defects 0,0) are bar-symmetric ⇒ pure even ⇒ clean q² angle, zero skew residual; H₂S's inequivalent lones (self-dual 3s² + chiral 3p_z, defects 0,2) give the chiral pair a bar-anti-symmetric (odd-in-h) part that opens the pure-p 90°. Parity check: the residual is odd in h (scale h·z²≈3° / h·z³≈1.5°, observed 2.1° between) — right parity and scale, not a clean single power. Exact value = the S³-embedding curvature integral (chirality residue), still open; the clean result is the bar-symmetric/anti-symmetric identification.

data.finding: The H₂S +2.1° is the bar-ANTI-symmetric (chiral / P_skew) residue. H₂O's two self-dual lone pairs are bar-symmetric (defects 0,0) ⇒ the angle is pure even ⇒ clean q² (104.5°), zero skew. H₂S's lones are inequivalent (self-dual 3s² + chiral 3p_z, defects 0,2); the chiral pair carries the odd-in-h bar-anti-symmetric part the framework normally projects away (P_skew: sin/sinh/Φ_q), surfacing here as the +2° opening of the pure-p 90°. The owner's 'cosh' (even) and 'chiral S³ curvature' (odd) directions are the two halves of the bar-involution. Parity confirmed (residual odd in h, scale h·z²..h·z³, 2.1° between). Exact value = the chirality-residue S³ curvature integral — open; the identification is the clean result.
